caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornately-designed pot, which has a bulbous body that tapers at the top and bottom, with a wide, circular base and a domed lid topped with a small knob and disk. The pot features a long, elegantly curved spout on the left side and a decorative handle with angular, stylized contours on the right side. Two horizontal bands encircle the upper and lower parts of the main body, and a similar band runs around the neck below the lid. The drawing is rendered entirely in fine, precise pencil lines on a yellowed, off-white piece of paper, with some brown stains and discoloration visible along the left and bottom edges. In the upper right corner, there is handwritten text that reads "COFFEE ~TEA~ POT" with the word "TEA" crossed out, and below that, "ARTIST" followed by a partially readable name.
title: Silver Coffee Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
